30970-miss-cayley-s-adventures.title: Miss Cayley S Adventures
30970-miss-cayley-s-adventures.creator: A. Conan Doyle.
30970-miss-cayley-s-adventures.description: A book by A. Conan Doyle.. It was my stepfather's death that drove me to it. I had never seen my stepfather. Indeed, I never even thought of him as anything more than Colonel Watts-Morgan. I owed him nothing, except my poverty.

arxiv-2110-12416.title: Sentence Punctuation for Collaborative Commentary Generation in Esports Live-Streaming
arxiv-2110-12416.creator: Hong Huang 1 , Junjie H. Xu 1, Xiaoling Ling, Pujana Paliyawan
arxiv-2110-12416.description: Abstract To solve the existing sentence punctuation problem for collaborative commentary generation in Esports live-streaming, this paper presents two strategies for sentence punctuation for text sequences of game commentary, that is, punctuating sentences by two or three text sequence(s) originally punctuated by Youtube to obtain a complete sentence of commentary.

arxiv-2402-04824.title: Learning Communication Policies for Different Follower Behaviors in a Collaborative Reference Game
arxiv-2402-04824.creator: Philipp Sadler, Sherzod Hakimovand David Schlangen
arxiv-2402-04824.description: Abstract Albrecht and Stone (2018) state that modeling of changing behaviors remains an open problem “due to the essentially unconstrained nature of what other agents may do”. In this work we evaluate the adaptability of neural artificial agents towards assumed partner behaviors in a collaborative reference game.

arxiv-2402-17356.title: Modulation of chiral anomaly and bilinear magnetoconductivity in Weyl semimetals by impurity-resonance states
arxiv-2402-17356.creator: Mei-Wei Hu 1, Zhuo-Yan Fang 1, Hou-Jian Duan 1,2, Mou Yang 1,2, Ming-Xun Deng 1,2, Rui-Qiang Wang 1,2
arxiv-2402-17356.description: Abstract The phenomenon of nonlinear transport has attracted tremendous interest within the condensed matter community. We present a theoretical framework for nonlinear transport based on the nonequilibrium retarded Green’s function, and examine the impact of disorder on nonlinear magnetotransport in Weyl semimetals (WSMs).

arxiv-2405-02982.title: Paintings and Drawings Aesthetics Assessment with Rich Attributes for Various Artistic Categories
arxiv-2405-02982.creator: Xin Jin, Qianqian Qiao, Huaye Wang, Shan Gao, Heng Huang, Guangdong Li
arxiv-2405-02982.description: Abstract Image aesthetic evaluation is a highly prominent research domain in the field of computer vision. In recent years, there has been a proliferation of datasets and corresponding evaluation methodologies for assessing the aesthetic quality of photographic works, leading to the establishment of a relatively mature research environment.

arxiv-2506-05008.title: Structure-Aware Radar-Camera Depth Estimation
arxiv-2506-05008.creator: Fuyi Zhang, Zhu Yu, Chunhao Li, Runmin Zhang, Xiaokai Bai, Zili Zhou, Si-Yuan Cao, Fang Wang, and, Hui-Liang Shen, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2506-05008.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Fuyi Zhang, Zhu Yu, Chunhao Li, Runmin Zhang, Xiaokai Bai, Zili Zhou, Si-Yuan Cao, Fang Wang, and, Hui-Liang Shen, Senior Member, IEEE. Radar has gained much attention in autonomous driving due to its accessibility and robustness. However, its standalone application for depth perception is constrained by issues of sparsity and noise. Radar-camera depth estimation offers a more promising complementary solution. Despite significant progress, current approaches fail to produce satisfactory dense depth maps, due to the unsatisfactory processing of the sparse and noisy radar data.

arxiv-2510-26060.title: Performance Analysis of Dynamic Equilibria in Joint Path Selection and Congestion Control
arxiv-2510-26060.creator: Sina Keshvadi
arxiv-2510-26060.description: Abstract Path-aware networking, a cornerstone of next-generation architectures like SCION and Multipath QUIC, empowers end-hosts with fine-grained control over traffic forwarding. This capability, however, introduces a critical stability risk: uncoordinated, greedy path selection by a multitude of agents can induce persistent, high-amplitude network oscillations. While this phenomenon is well-known, its quantitative performance impact across key metrics has remained poorly understood.

arxiv-2512-04974.title: Efficient Generative Transformer Operators for Million-Point PDEs
arxiv-2512-04974.creator: Armand Kassaï Koupaï, Lise Le Boudec, Patrick Gallinari
arxiv-2512-04974.description: Abstract We introduce ECHO , a transformer–operator framework for generating million-point PDE trajectories. While existing neural operators (NOs) have shown promise for solving partial differential equations, they remain limited in practice due to poor scalability on dense grids, error accumulation during dynamic unrolling, and task-specific design. ECHO addresses these challenges through three key innovations.

plos-pone-0003786.creator: Peyman Khorsand, Frances Chance
plos-pone-0003786.description: PLOS ONE research article. The mean input and variance of the total synaptic input to a neuron can vary independently, suggesting two distinct information channels. Here we examine the impact of rapidly varying signals, delivered via these two information conduits, on the temporal dynamics of neuronal firi

plos-pone-0338576.creator: Bohye Jeong, Peter Stoilov
plos-pone-0338576.description: A single Musashi gene allele is sufficient to maintain mouse photoreceptor cells

pmc-10730415.title: Single-session visuospatial task procedure to prevent childbirth-related posttraumatic stress disorder: a multicentre double-blind randomised controlled trial
pmc-10730415.creator: Camille Deforges, Vania Sandoz, Yvonnick Noël, Valérie Avignon, David Desseauve, Julie Bourdin, Yvan Vial, Susan Ayers, Emily A. Holmes, Manuella Epiney, Antje Horsch
pmc-10730415.description: Preventive evidence-based interventions for childbirth-related posttraumatic stress disorder (CB-PTSD) are lacking. Yet, 18.5% of women develop CB-PTSD symptoms following an unplanned caesarean section (UCS). This two-arm, multicentre, double-blind superiority trial tested the efficacy of an early single-session intervention including a visuospatial task on the prevention of maternal CB-PTSD symptoms. The intervention was delivered by trained maternity clinicians.

pmc-11464793.title: The prognostic impact of Her2 status in early triple negative breast cancer: a Turkish Oncology Group (TOG) study
pmc-11464793.creator: Neslihan Özyurt, Ali Alkan, Burcu Gülbağcı, Mustafa Seyyar, Esra Aşık, Mustafa Şahbazlar, Mehmet Türker, Oğuzcan Kınıkoğlu, Tahir Yerlikaya, Gülhan Dinç, Ali Aytaç, Ziya Kalkan, Senar Ebinç, İlkay Gültürk, Merve Keskinkılıç, Zehra Sucuoğlu İşleyen, Dilek Çağlayan, Alper Türkel, Esra Aydın, Teoman Şa
pmc-11464793.description: The studies evaluating the impact of Her2 levels in neoadjuvant setting have conflicting data. The aim of the study was to evaluate the prognostic impact of Her2 status in early triple negative breast cancer(TNBC). In the study TNBC patients who were treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) and surgery were analyzed retrospectively.

pmc-11586691.title: Mechanistically Different Mechanochromophores Enable Calibration and Validation of Molecular Forces in Glassy Polymers and Elastomeric Networks
pmc-11586691.creator: Raphael Hertel, Maximilian Raisch, Michael Walter, Günter Reiter, Michael Sommer
pmc-11586691.description: Sterically distorted donor‐acceptor π‐systems, termed DA springs, can be progressively planarized under mechanical load causing a bathochromic shift of the photoluminescence (PL) spectrum. By combining theory and experiment, we here use a simple linear force calibration for two different conformational mechanochromophores to determine molecular forces in polymers from the mechanochromic shift in PL wavelength during multiple uniaxial tensile tests.

pmc-12608426.title: Over-Represented Senescent Keratinocytes in Hyperpigmented Spots Promote Melanocyte Activation via IGFBP3 and NGF
pmc-12608426.creator: Tomohiro Hakozaki, Holly Rovito, Bradley B Jarrold, John Snowball, Jiazhen Wang, Wenzhu Zhao, Timothy Laughlin, Luigi Casella
pmc-12608426.description: The occurrence and impact of cellular senescence on skin aging and hyperpigmentation is an ongoing area of exploration, encompassing both intrinsic and extrinsic stressors. Traditionally, research has focused on melanocyte and fibroblast senescence due to their slower turnover compared to keratinocytes.

pmc-12730758.title: Risk factors for cancer among the working population in China: a cross-sectional analysis of baseline data from the WECAN project
pmc-12730758.creator: Kaige Sun, Baohua Wang, Feng J He, Puhong Zhang, Ning Wang, Yuan Li, Rong Luo, Changqiong Wang, Guangming Yi, Ting Yang, Lishu Zhou, Juan Zhou, Guohong Zhang, Jing Wu
pmc-12730758.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to assess the prevalence of cancer risk factors in China’s working population and provide evidence for formulating more targeted workplace cancer prevention strategies.DesignA cross-sectional study utilising the baseline data from the Comprehensive Workplace Intervention for Cancer Prevention in China (WECAN) project, a stepped-wedge cluster randomised controlled trial.

pmc-13050338.title: Stringy Corrections to Heterotic SU(3)-Geometry
pmc-13050338.creator: Jock McOrist, Sebastien Picard
pmc-13050338.description: We analyse the α′2 corrections to the supersymmetry algebra constructed by Bergshoeff–de Roo for heterotic compactifications on SU(3) manifolds. The geometry is complex and conformally balanced. Starting from these supersymmetry constraints, we derive the equations of motions and find that the graviton equation contains an extraneous term which can be set to zero after gauge fixing.

pmc-13241932.title: Early diagnostic accuracy of immature platelet fraction for sepsis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13241932.creator: Sinta Wiranata, Ida Bagus Amertha Putra Manuaba, I Gede Putu Supadmanaba, I Putu Yuda Prabawa, Anak Agung Wiradewi Lestari
pmc-13241932.description: BackgroundThe immature platelet fraction, a rapid and accessible indicator of bone marrow thrombopoietic activity, is considered a possible biomarker for the early diagnosis of sepsis. This study aims to evaluate the diagnostic precision of immature platelet fraction testing for the early identification of sepsis. This is, to our knowledge, the first systematic review and meta-analysis addressing this problem.

pmc-13326349.title: Removal of scleral buckle: indications, long-term outcomes and comparison with the literature
pmc-13326349.creator: Eunice Linh You, Sihame Doukkali, Mélanie Hébert, Mohammadhossein Ghasempourabadi, Kelvin You, David Jin, Serge Bourgault, Mathieu Caissie, Éric Tourville, Ali Dirani
pmc-13326349.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo assess the clinical indications for scleral buckle removal (SBR) and evaluate the functional and anatomic outcomes, including the risk of recurrent retinal detachment (RD) following SBR.DesignRetrospective chart review.MethodsA single-center analysis of patients operated for SBR was conducted at the Centre hospitalier universitaire de Québec – Université Laval in Quebec, Canada between 2008 and 2023 with a minimum of 1 year follow-up.

pmc-13398366.title: A Pharmacogenomics‐Guided Antihypertensive Strategy for Blood Pressure Reduction in Rural China: A Cluster‐Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13398366.creator: Wangjun Qin, Mengke Yu, Ying Zhu, Queran Lin, Limei Yin, Guisheng Liu, Yaping Wang, Guangqiang Lu, Xiaofei Liu, Pengmei Li, Xudong Kong, Li Zhao, Kun Tang, Jiangli Jin, Yu Xiong, Yingnan Zhao, Yan Yan, Bo Li, Azeem Majeed, Xianbo Zuo, Yue Qiu, Jiantuo Yu, Lihong Liu

pmc-13578407.title: Development of long-term oyster explant cultures enable sustained tissue-specific activity and reveal novel cellular behaviours
pmc-13578407.creator: Kallen R Sullivan, Pieter C Steketee, Scott Maxwell, Liam J Morrison, Tim Regan, Tim P Bean
pmc-13578407.description: Molluscs are ecologically and economically important, yet progress in understanding their cellular biology has been limited by the lack of reliable cell culture systems. Here, we establish reproducible long-term in vitro and ex vivo cultures from multiple tissues of the European flat oyster, Ostrea edulis, including heart, visceral mass, mantle, and gill.

pmc-13600016.title: Simultaneous Percutaneous Spinal Cord Stimulation Lead Placement During Spine Surgery
pmc-13600016.creator: Hiroshi Inagaki
pmc-13600016.description: Spinal cord stimulation (SCS) is an established neuromodulatory therapy for refractory chronic pain; however, the timing of SCS initiation has received relatively little attention. In some patients requiring spine surgery, the indication for SCS is already present at the time of surgery.

pmc-13627352.title: Case Report: Arthroscopic management of a giant Baker cyst containing numerous rice body-like loose bodies in a patient with rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-13627352.creator: Yang Li, Yong Cao, Hangyu Li, Jinxin Gu, Jiasheng Ma, Linlin He, Xiaojun Ma, Jun Wan
pmc-13627352.description: BackgroundGiant Baker cysts containing numerous rice body-like loose bodies are uncommon and can resemble vascular, infectious, or neoplastic lesions.Case presentationA 30-year-old woman with a 4-year history of rheumatoid arthritis presented with 1 year of progressive left knee pain, restricted flexion, and a 15 × 8 cm nonpulsatile mass extending from the popliteal fossa into the proximal calf.
